# Error codes

<!-- Generated by `task docs` from skilling.conformance. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every finding `skilling validate` reports carries a code, a location, and an anchor into the
specification. Codes are **immutable**: never renamed, never renumbered, never reused. If a
code's meaning has to change it is retired and a new one is added, because people build CI on
these strings.

The specification itself carries no per-rule identifiers. Identifiers belong to the tool that
emits them, and version with it.

```
error  course.yaml:14  lesson-number-duplicate
       Phase 0 has two lessons numbered 4.
       → spec/course-format.md#numbering-and-structure
```

## Severities

| Severity | Meaning | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `error` | The course does not conform | `skilling validate` exits non-zero |
| `warning` | Conforming, but probably not what was meant | Exits zero unless `--strict` |


## The manifest as a document

Problems reading `course.yaml` at all, or with the values in it.

| Code | Severity | What it means | Specification |
|---|---|---|---|
| `manifest-missing` | error | No course.yaml at the course root | [directory-structure](../spec/course-format.md#directory-structure) |
| `manifest-unparseable` | error | course.yaml is not valid YAML | [the-manifest](../spec/course-format.md#the-manifest) |
| `manifest-invalid` | error | course.yaml has a missing, mistyped, or unknown field | [manifest-fields](../spec/course-format.md#manifest-fields) |
| `spec-version-unsupported` | error | spec_version names a major version this tool cannot read | [manifest-fields](../spec/course-format.md#manifest-fields) |
| `spec-version-newer-minor` | warning | spec_version names a newer minor version than this tool | [manifest-fields](../spec/course-format.md#manifest-fields) |
| `course-id-invalid` | error | id is not lowercase kebab-case within 1-64 characters | [manifest-fields](../spec/course-format.md#manifest-fields) |
| `course-version-invalid` | error | version is not a semantic version | [course-versions](../spec/course-format.md#course-versions) |
| `license-unknown` | error | license is neither an SPDX identifier nor 'proprietary' | [manifest-fields](../spec/course-format.md#manifest-fields) |
| `badge-id-duplicate` | error | Two registered skills share an id | [manifest-fields](../spec/course-format.md#manifest-fields) |


## Structure, across the manifest and the disk

The manifest and the files under `phases/` must agree exactly, and numbering must leave no gaps.

| Code | Severity | What it means | Specification |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phase-number-duplicate` | error | Two phases share a number | [numbering-and-structure](../spec/course-format.md#numbering-and-structure) |
| `phase-numbering-gap` | error | Phase numbers do not ascend by exactly 1 from 0 or 1 | [numbering-and-structure](../spec/course-format.md#numbering-and-structure) |
| `lesson-number-duplicate` | error | Two lessons in a phase share a number | [numbering-and-structure](../spec/course-format.md#numbering-and-structure) |
| `lesson-numbering-gap` | error | Lesson numbers do not ascend by exactly 1 from 1 | [numbering-and-structure](../spec/course-format.md#numbering-and-structure) |
| `lesson-file-missing` | error | The manifest lists a lesson with no file at its derived path | [numbering-and-structure](../spec/course-format.md#numbering-and-structure) |
| `lesson-file-orphan` | error | A lesson file on disk does not appear in the manifest | [numbering-and-structure](../spec/course-format.md#numbering-and-structure) |
| `frontmatter-manifest-mismatch` | error | A lesson's title, phase, or lesson number disagrees with the manifest | [frontmatter](../spec/course-format.md#frontmatter) |
| `homework-declaration-mismatch` | error | The manifest's homework flag and the lesson's Homework Assignment section disagree | [numbering-and-structure](../spec/course-format.md#numbering-and-structure) |
| `badge-unregistered` | error | skills_unlocked names a badge not registered in the manifest | [frontmatter](../spec/course-format.md#frontmatter) |
| `prerequisite-unresolved` | error | A prerequisite coordinate does not exist in the manifest | [frontmatter](../spec/course-format.md#frontmatter) |
| `authored-count` | error | A structural count is written down instead of derived from the manifest | [derived-counts](../spec/course-format.md#derived-counts) |

## Ceremony

The `ceremony` block, since spec 1.1. Templates are learner-facing, so they are held to the same rules as a lesson body.

| Code | Severity | What it means | Specification |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ceremony-unknown-placeholder` | error | A ceremony template uses a placeholder no runtime can fill | [placeholders](../spec/course-format.md#placeholders) |
| `ceremony-highlight-missing` | error | A template uses {phase_highlight} but a phase has no highlight to fill it with | [placeholders](../spec/course-format.md#placeholders) |
| `ceremony-handle-malformed` | warning | A social handle does not begin with '@' | [ceremony](../spec/course-format.md#ceremony) |


## Structured objectives

Addressable learning objectives, since spec 1.1; kinds and verification since 1.2. `about` steers remediation and is never evidence — a quiz settles nothing.

| Code | Severity | What it means | Specification |
|---|---|---|---|
| `objectives-declared-twice` | error | Objectives are declared in frontmatter and as a section; they are mutually exclusive | [structured-objectives](../spec/course-format.md#structured-objectives) |
| `objective-id-duplicate` | error | Two objectives in one lesson share an id | [structured-objectives](../spec/course-format.md#structured-objectives) |
| `objective-about-invalid` | error | An objective's about names a quiz question that does not exist | [remediation-not-evidence](../spec/course-format.md#remediation-not-evidence) |
| `objective-verify-on-knowledge` | error | A knowledge objective carries verify or check; only practice can be observed | [verifying-a-practice-objective](../spec/course-format.md#verifying-a-practice-objective) |
| `objective-check-without-verify` | error | A check with no verify leaves nothing saying what is being established | [verifying-a-practice-objective](../spec/course-format.md#verifying-a-practice-objective) |

48 codes: 45 errors, 3 warnings.

## Using codes in CI

```bash
skilling validate ./my-course --json
```

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "errors": 1,
  "warnings": 0,
  "findings": [
    {
      "code": "quiz-answer-no-reason",
      "severity": "error",
      "message": "Question 2's answer names the correct option but gives no reason...",
      "path": "phases/phase-1-basics/lesson-02-going-further.md",
      "line": 61,
      "anchor": "spec/course-format.md#quick-quiz"
    }
  ]
}
```

Filter on `code`, never on `message` — messages are prose and may be reworded in a patch
release. That is the point of having codes at all.
